notes.title: Patch Notes v0.14.2 - Feedback Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/c66a61490a3e793257ba863613c34c081dd16cd8.png"][/img][b]⭐ Fields of Mistria patch v0.14.2 is here! This smaller update focuses on implementing various QoL improvements and fixes based on player feedback. As always, thank you to everyone who provides feedback and reports bugs to us![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]🐛[/b] [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSddD0NOildbVAFI5Z02Cyhuw6bk1j4cUqAdr7jz_-ScMJuVYA/viewform?usp=dialog"][b]Bug Report Form[/b][/url][/p][p][b]📝 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSec6IOBh-4hZ0o3np2kO6XzbiUmguiF5ssaS-X066FAwaq2Nw/viewform?usp=header"]General Feedback Form[/url][/b][/p][p][b]💥 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf3If2Z0r1ByUbm0WBnAmmbg7qhgFahQuyZ5MEWXS36rMsWBA/viewform?usp=dialog"][u]Silent Crash Report Form[/u][/url][/b][/p][p][i]We are aware that a small number of players are experiencing silent crashes (crashes that do not display a crash report message). In order to help us address these crashes, we ask that players use this form to provide additional details.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch notes will feature a 🌼 emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback and bug reporting![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]0.14.2 Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]\[Highlights][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Trees and farm buildings now become translucent when the player walks behind them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Crafting UIs now have a MAX button, allowing players to easily craft the maximum possible amount of items (now up to 999).[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Bug spawn rates have been adjusted and improved across the game for balancing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Players can now buy bundles of wood and stone from the Carpenter’s Shop. Bundles are available in stacks of 20 and 100.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Experience gained from Woodcrafting, Combat, and Fishing has been adjusted and improved for balancing. [i]Note: Updating to 0.14.2 will adjust your skill levels upward to reflect new skill progression.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[New Features][/b][/p][p][b]✨ QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Inn now sells Salt and Pepper Shakers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]New Storage UI icons have been added: Vegetable, fruit, flower, insect, monster, and seashell.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now have the ability to disable High-Res Screen Buffer and Smooth Camera Tracking in the Display Settings menu. [i]Note: Disabling these settings may improve performance at the expense of smoother gameplay visuals.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎨 Art[/b][/p][list][*][p]New cosmetics have been added to Wheedle’s Stall: The Court Set, Dancer Set, and Rogue Set.[/p][/*][*][p]A new furniture item has been added to Wheedle’s Stall: Animated Bird Fountain.[/p][/*][*][p]New furniture and cosmetic item drops have been added to Mist Spots.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]💛 NPCs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Additional NPC dialogue has been added to the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Updates][/b][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Legendary insects are no longer restricted to being found at certain times of day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Adjusted bug spawn rates in the Upper Mines biome to match other Mines biomes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Summon Rain spell now petrifies Lava Cats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Animals can now eat and be hand-fed Wheat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Mines fish now count towards the Crown Request for Fish.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]✨ QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Reading a letter with items attached now automatically acquires the item even if the player exits without hitting the “Take Items” button. [i]Note: all unclaimed items from previously read letters will be dropped to the ground in front of the mailbox upon updating to 0.14.2.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Crafting large quantities of items now drops them in stacks instead of individually.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Essence Stone tooltips now display charge time information visually.[/p][/*][*][p]When returning to the “Your Animals” side of the Animal Daycare menu, the previous cursor position is now restored rather than defaulting to the top of the animal list.[/p][/*][*][p]The description for the perk Deliberate Debris has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]The description for the perk Mist Sight has been updated[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Date cutscenes are now skippable.[/p][/*][*][p]Various optimizations have been made for the user interface graphics.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎨 Art[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Inn candles are now lit.[/p][/*][*][p]The colors of Blackberry and Wintergreen bushes in Fall have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Misc. UI icon edits have been made.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]💛 NPCs[/b][/p][list][*][p]Romanceable NPCs now wear their beach outfit on the Beach Dates in Summer.[/p][/*][*][p]The Harvest Festival Dance is now a romantic Date, complete with a new Photo Card.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Wheedle now sells the Deluxe Pink Storage Chest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Certain[b] [/b]NPC dialogues have had their conditions updated to better account for things like player progress and heart level. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Perfect Emerald and Perfect Diamond are now dropping at the intended rate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Magic Plant Crop Sign is now unlocked for players who had unlocked the Spring Crop Sign Set before the item was added to the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Multiple legendary fish can no longer be obtained by triggering the Lucky Haul perk.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Repair the General Store quest requirement has been fixed to require 5 Iron Ingots as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Storage Chest’s “Locked” icon no longer resets when closing the UI.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Essence Bat attacks now pause when the game is paused.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Crown Request for Golden Ingredients now accepts Golden Duck Mayonnaise as a valid shipped item.[/p][/*][*][p]Essence-powered machines now drop leftover Essence when destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]The Silver Redhorse fish is no longer edible[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Animals no longer rarely eat immediately at 6 am instead of 10 am.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Skipping a story cutscene that uses player Health and Stamina will now cause them to deplete as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Players can no longer obtain multiple legendary fish in a day by swimming through Fish Schools with the School Crasher perk.[/p][/*][*][p]Animals no longer get stuck inside collisions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]✨ QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Festival Quests no longer appear as read by default in the Quest UI in Year 2 and beyond.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🎨 Art & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted Enchantern’s visuals when the “Out of Juice” perk is activated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed alignment in Lava Cave decor items: Diamond and Gold Rock.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Mistmare now correctly updates its appearance to match the chosen animal’s cosmetics.[/p][/*][*][p]The transition into the Large Greenhouses is now aligned with the door.[/p][/*][*][p]A small visual error in the Pink Deluxe Icebox item icon has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The boarded-up Mines Entry doorway now appears correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Animal shadows now appear correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Snowy footprints no longer appear inside the Greenhouses in Winter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The player’s house now displays properly in Fall.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected eyeshadow color on two of Juniper’s portraits.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]💛 NPCs[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Misc. dialogue fixes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Players can no longer give NPCs an extra birthday gift by gifting them past midnight the day before their birthday.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🖥️[b] UI[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Fishing Tutorial no longer triggers twice if the player acquires multiple Fishing Rods at once.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Crown Requests no longer show the number of already shipped items in the UI before the request is accepted.[/p][/*][*][p]An NPC the player dates on Saturday will no longer appear in the Calendar “Date Available” preview on Sunday.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]❌ Crash Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Multiple sound effects playing at once, ex. multiple sprinklers going off, no longer crashes the game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🌼[/b]In rare cases, animals finishing grazing will no longer crash the game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]UPDATE: 0.14.3 Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]We have released patch v0.14.3 to fix a few higher-priority and misc. bugs introduced in the v0.14.2 version of the game. [/b][/p][p][i]Note: A prior hotfix released shortly after 0.14.2 did not address these issues as intended. We recommend verifying the integrity of your game files to ensure your version is now v0.14.3 on the title screen.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Updates][/b][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Adjusted bug spawn rates that were over tuned in v0.14.2.[/p][/*][*][p]🌼Bugs can now appear on the player farm again as intended.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]✨ QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p]If a save can’t be written to disk due to insufficient available storage, the game will now display a pop-up instead of crashing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p][b]🎨 Art & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the Small Red Coop’s shadow appearance to better match its collision area.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]❌ Crash Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Interacting with dive spots with the Lucky Haul perk activated no longer crashes the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Inspecting crafting scrolls with a large number of item previews no longer crashes the game (this was primarily reported as occurring while navigating Merri's stall).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you as always for your feedback, and we hope you enjoy these QoL improvements! Stay tuned in the coming weeks for more information on our roadmap and plans for our next major update.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.14.1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/711f1a06804d7ff6cedd2aab22c23692bd418218.png"][/img][/p][p][b]⭐ Fields of Mistria v0.14.1 Patch[/b][/p][p][b]We have released a patch to fix a few higher-priority and miscellaneous bugs introduced in the v0.14.0 version of the game. Thank you for bringing these issues to our attention so we were able to fix them quickly 💛[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]You can use the following forms to submit your own reports:[/b][/p][p][b]🐛 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSek8X5tUjV4HZ80u_oonhzK5nKIY_lXnyHg9iiLbdd5BTlIYg/viewform"][u]Bug Report Form[/u][/url][/b][/p][p][b]📝 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdzKPBu5sVZlEvjJLFe95a4OlyepNvWgxV4UkRA4e5NMXq5pg/viewform"][u]General Feedback Form[/u][/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch notes will feature a 🌼 emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback and bug reporting![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]0.14.1 Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]\[Highlights][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼 [/b]The tooltip on seeds has been restored to display all intended information.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼 [/b]The ability to navigate to other pages at Darcy’s Stall, Hayden’s Shop, and any Store menus that have 2 pages in them has been restored to function as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]The journal now displays “Best Friend” instead of “Single” if the player has chosen an NPC's “Best Friend” route during their 8 Heart Event, further clarifying the current status within that menu.[/p][/*][*][p]An interact bubble has been added to the Harvest Festival Feast Table and Pumpkin Patch sign to further clarify that these are interactable locations.[/p][/*][*][p]🌼Fixed a bug where Adeline's romantic status could sometimes switch from "Dating" to "Best Friends" after Eiland's 8 Heart Event. [i]Note: If, after updating to 0.14.1, Adeline remains on the "Best Friend" route (listed in the Journal) despite choosing the "Dating" route in her 8 Heart Event, please load a previous Save File from before Eiland's 8 Heart Event to reset Adeline's route.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[Updates][/b][/p][p][b]✨ QOL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved furniture and sapling preview placement UX.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Requests will more reliably appear on the Request Board if valid requests are available.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]💛 NPCs[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Wheedle’s Likes have been updated to correct a duplicate liked item.[/p][/*][*][p]Balor’s 8 Heart Event letter name has been updated, and his quest objective has been clarified.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Dialogue typos have been corrected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Water Sprite Statues in greenhouses now work as intended if the player leaves while they are activated and/or if it is raining or snowing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Players can no longer attend the Shooting Star Festival with an NPC on the evening of the Harvest Festival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Players can no longer obtain a Shooting Star Date Photo Card before Dating an NPC.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Shooting Star Festival scene no longer interrupts Celine’s 8 Heart Event if players trigger it on Summer 28.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Fixed NPCs from reverting to lower-level heart dialogue for one in-game day after loading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Merri no longer sells Craft Decor Set items and recipes. The recipes are now available to purchase at Balor’s Wagon as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Mist Spots no longer respawn if the player exits and reenters the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Animals no longer eat the food in their troughs before 10am.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The “Upgrade the Carpenter’s Shop” questline now correctly appears at renown lvl 70 when all other upgrade questlines have been completed, including the new Saturday Market upgrade.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🎨 Art & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Purple Saplings can no longer jump into the void.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🖥️[b] UI[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Letters now address the player by their correct name, rather than referring to them as the placeholder name “Ari”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]The Inventory Management controls page in Storage menus now displays “Pick Up One”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Players can no longer swap armor into the incorrect slots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Hayden and Olric’s portraits now display correctly during one of their group conversations.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]❌ Crash Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Hitting E while holding a Clod Bomb no longer crashes the game.[i] Note: Clod Bombs are thrown using G - the Throw Item control.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Obtaining a Shooting Star Date Photo Card while the player's inventory is full no longer crashes the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌼[/b]Updating a save file where the player has a status effect applied no longer crashes the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Beloved Stardew Valley rival's new update finally lets you romance villagers
notes.content:
It's difficult to rival the cozy perfection of Stardew Valley, but Fields of Mistria is certainly doing a great job. With a 97% Steam rating from over 20,000 players, it's safe to say that this magical life sim has enchanted many since hitting early access last year. And now love is in the air, as its third major update finally adds romance and allows you to take other villagers on dates.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Fields of Mistria's Third Major Update & Patch Notes are here!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/665bb18fbfcbe3ea3945f706aa922ff19f92ee69.png"][/img][/p][p][b]⭐ We are delighted to announce that Fields of Mistria's Third Major Update has arrived! [/b][/p][p][b]This patch introduces our 3rd Major Update features and QOL updates requested by the community, along with additional crash and bug fixes. As always, thank you to everyone who reported bugs and provided feedback to us![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]🐛 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSek8X5tUjV4HZ80u_oonhzK5nKIY_lXnyHg9iiLbdd5BTlIYg/viewform"][u]Bug Report Form[/u][/url][/b][/p][p][b]📝 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdzKPBu5sVZlEvjJLFe95a4OlyepNvWgxV4UkRA4e5NMXq5pg/viewform"][u]General Feedback Form[/u][/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Patch notes will feature a 🌼 emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback and bug reporting![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]0.14.0 Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Highlights][/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]8 Heart Events for romanceable NPCs have been added to the game! During these 8H events, the player can choose whether to move forward as “Best Friends” or “Dating” with each. [i]Note: Players can date multiple NPCs at the same time, but will only be able to ultimately marry one. Marriage is not in this update.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]A new Dating mechanic has been added to the game! Players will be able to take NPCs with the “Dating” status on dates each weekend. Players will also receive a Photo Card commemorating the first Date of each type. [i]Note: To unlock Dates, players must have at least one NPC with the “Dating” status chosen. New Date types can be found and unlocked via “Date Inspiration” items.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]The Harvest Festival arrives on Fall 10th! Participate in the Queen Berry gathering competition (starts Fall 7th) to win various rewards, enjoy a delicious feast, and even ask an NPC to dance with you after the judging![/i][/p][/*][*][p]Taliferro has been added as a vendor to the Saturday Market! Players can compete in his weekly Cooking Challenge for rewards and renown. [i]Note: Players must complete the “Upgrading the Saturday Market” questline to unlock him.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Wheedle has been added as a vendor to the Saturday Market! He runs a shop that sells high end and unique items. [i]Note: Players must complete the “Upgrading the Saturday Market” questline to unlock him.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Greenhouses can now be purchased at the Carpenter's Shop. Crops in greenhouses grow year-round and furniture items can be placed inside. [i]Note: Players must complete the “Upgrade the Carpenter’s Shop” questline to unlock greenhouses.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]🌼 [/b]Large and extra-large storage chests are now available! The following storage chests have been updated to the “Large” size: Lovely Cottage Icebox, Obsidian Storage Chest, Coral Storage Chest, Stone Storage Chest, and the Breath of Spring Storage Chest.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[New Features][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]🎮 Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]The "Upgrade the Saturday Market" questline is now available. [i]Note: To unlock this questline, the player must have completed all previous town repair quests and achieve Renown Lvl 65.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]The "Upgrade the Carpenter's Shop" questline is now available. [i]Note: To unlock this questline, the player must have completed all previous town repair quests and achieve Renown Lvl 70.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Players can now apply 3 different buffs to their swords (Fire, Ice and Venom) using Snake Oil purchased from Wheedle’s Saturday Market Stall[/p][/*][*][p]Home Upgrade 4 is available to purchase from the Carpenter’s Shop! The upgrade adds a second story to the player's home. There are three placeable items that allow access to the upper floors: stairs, a ladder, or a teleportation pad. [i]Note: Players must complete the “Upgrade the Carpenter’s Shop” questline to unlock Home Upgrade 4.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New Cooked dish recipe scrolls are now available.[/p][/*][*][p]The Renown cap has been raised to 95, and there are new rewards for levels 91-95.[/p][/*][*][p]The Skill Cap has been raised from 45 to 60.[/p][/*][*][p]New Skill Perks have been added to the game for Tier 4 and 5:[/p][list][*][p]Farming:[/p][list][*][p]Earthly Essence[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Design[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fishing:[/p][list][*][p]Abyssal Ascendence[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Archaeology:[/p][list][*][p]Natural Beauty II[/p][/*][*][p]Mist Sight[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Woodcrafting: [/p][list][*][p]Working with the Grain II[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cooking: [/p][list][*][p]Fairy Cooking[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Combat [/p][list][*][p]Guardian’s Shield II[/p][/*][*][p]True Strike II[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]A new Museum set has been added: the Mist Artifact Set.[/p][/*][*][p]Some monster variants from the Deep Earth biome have been updated with new behaviors: Blue Mushroom, Purple Sapling, Green Rockclod, and the Silverclod.[/p][/*][*][p]The Lava Cat, a new monster, has been added to the Lava Caves biome.[/p][/*][*][p]The Flame Spirit, a new monster, has been added to the Lava Caves biome. [/p][/*][*][p]Players can now catch Clod projectiles with the bug net. notes.content:

[b]We are delighted to announce that Fields of Mistria's Second Major Update has arrived!

[list]

[list]
[*] Wheedle’s voice has been adjusted.
[*] The Stalagmite monster’s damage sound has been updated.
[/list]

[b][Bug Fixes]
🎮 Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] 🌼 Floating items no longer snap to a room’s center when placing a table down.
[*] 🌼 Animals will now eat grass even if the player is not present.
[*] 🌼 Players can no longer get stuck in the Bathhouse by immediately skipping the Bathhouse Cutscene.
[*] 🌼 Riding the Mistmare to the Summit during the Shooting Star Festival before 8 PM no longer triggers the event.
[*] 🌼 Players can no longer get stuck in furniture placed near Caldarus’ statue after viewing cutscenes near the statue.
[*] 🌼 Players can no longer walk on water after diving into dive spots near rocks.
[*] Being hit by a monster while throwing an item no longer causes the item to disappear.
[*] 🌼 The Blue Essence Bat’s hitbox has been updated to the correct size.
[*] Clicking out of the game window during a room transition will no longer break NPC pathing.
[*] The Weather Crystal Ball now predicts blizzard weather accurately.
[*] 🌼 Players can no longer perform a jump attack while holding an animal.
[*] Adjusted Treasure Rooms and Ritual Chambers to appear more consistently throughout the Mines.
[*] Closing the Journal while inputting a direction no longer causes players to pause briefly.
[*] While the Mistmare’s “Select An Appearance” popup is active, players can no longer scroll the Animals menu in the background.
[/list]

[b]✨ QOL[/b]
[list]
[*] 🌼 Shiny Beads will no longer appear out of bounds.
[*] 🌼 Animals will no longer eat Stamina Up Potions or Heart Crystals.
[*] Players can no longer unbind the first input slot in the Control Menu.

[b]🎨 Art & Visuals[/b]

[*] Player animation is no longer static when riding a mount.
[*] You can no longer place furniture directly on top of animals.
[*] 🌼 NPCs no longer perform special animations (reading/forging) in incorrect places.
[*] 🔊 Sound

[b]🖥️ UI[/b]

[*] Item names no longer spillover on the End of Day Summary screen.
[*] 🌼 HUD numbers now turn off when deselecting “Show HUD Numbers” in the Gameplay Settings menu.
[*] ❌ Crash Fixes
[*] 🌼 Carrying a small animal with you to the Shooting Star Festival scene no longer crashes the game.

[*] Activating the Frenzy Perk in the Mines no longer crashes the game.
[*] 🌼 Fixed a rare crash related to building the Small Coop.
[*] Rapidly opening and closing Inbox letters no longer crashes the game.
[*] 🌼Fixed a rare crash when selecting 'Restocking Mistria’s Food Reserves 2' in the Quest UI.
[*] 🌼 Selling an animal you’ve brought into Hayden’s Shop no longer crashes the game.

[b]
As always, thank you so much for your support. We hope you enjoy this update![/b]

We have released a patch to fix a few higher-priority and miscellaneous bugs introduced in the v0.13.0 version of the game. Thank you for bringing these issues to our attention so we were able to fix them quickly 💛[/b]

notes.title: Fields of Mistria's First Major Update & Patch Notes are here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/75e03f3af5790288de7f7923f3f683a2f6ee0bd3.png[/img]

[b]We are delighted to announce that Fields of Mistria's First Major Update has arrived! [/b]

This patch introduces our 1st Major Update features, QOL updates requested by the community, along with additional crash and bug fixes. As always, Thank you to everyone who’s reported bugs and provided feedback to us! To send your bugs or feedback, please the following forms:

🐛 Bug Report Form: https://forms.gle/xueb6C3SLMVn2g697

📝 General Feedback Form: https://forms.gle/m927ZNtWdFqk75Wk8


Below is a summary of the key features introduced in this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}43186863/a166d672b7bce327c9a9a0cbd90e11f6c43b2a0d.png[/img]

FIXES: ⭐ Fields of Mistria v0.12.1 Patch

We have released a patch to fix a bug in the v0.12.0 release that caused some players' objects to disappear from their farms. We also fixed a crash associated with  the "Restocking Mistria's Food Reserves" questline.

Thank you for bringing these issues to our attention so we were able to fix them quickly 💛

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Full 0.12.0  Patch Notes:[/b]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[i][b]Patch notes will feature a 🌼 emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback and bug reporting![/b][/i]

[b][Highlights][/b]

[list]
[*] Romanceable’s Six Heart Events have been added.

[*] Rideable mounts and mount-specific Skill Perks have been added. 
[i]Note: The “Upgrade Hayden’s Barn” quest must be finished in order to unlock the Mount Questline.[/i]

[*] The Shooting Star Festival on Summer 28 has been added.
[i]Note: To experience the date aspect of the festival, the “Beautification Project” quest must be completed. To invite a Romanceable NPC, their Heart Level must be 4+.[/i]

[*] Two new home upgrades are now available.

[*] 21 new Tier 4 Skill Perks have been added ([i]see [New Features] for more details[/i]).

[*] A new special type of Request Board request called "Crown Requests" has been added 
([i]see [New Features] for more details[/i]).

[*] New museum sets and rewards have been added for the Insect, Archaeology, and Fish wings.

[*] Saturday Market vendors (Louis, Vera, and Merri) have new items in stock.

[*] Two new monsters can be found in the Mines - the Essence Bat and the Mimic.
[/list]

[b][New Features][/b]

🎮 Gameplay

[list]
[*] The Renown level cap has been raised from 50 to 70, with new rewards to obtain.

[*] All skills can now be leveled up to level 45, unlocking 21 new Tier 4 perks: 2 Archaeology, 3 Farming, 3 Fishing, 3 Ranching, 3 Cooking, 3 Woodcrafting, 1 Blacksmithing, 2 Combat, 1 Mining. Some notable highlights:

- [Mining] Lost to History: Ritual Chamber rooms can now spawn in the Mines. These rooms contain new collectible items.

- [Ranching] The Bell Tolls: Unlocks the Big Bell item, which calls in/out all animals on the farm when used.

- [Farming] Sickle Sword: Unlock to use your sword to harvest crops quickly.

- [Crafting] Deliberate Debris: Farm debris will spawn 50% less often. 
[/list][list]
[*] 🌼 One new Tier 3 Ranching Skill Perk has been added:

- Wind Down: The Mill Time for all mill recipes will be reduced by 10 minutes.

[*] Crown Requests: After achieving Town Rank Sapphire (Lv 50), special Request Board quests called “Crown Requests” will begin appearing once a week. These requests reward more Renown than a regular request.

[*] 25 new requests have been added to the Request Board.

[*] Monsters in the Mines each have a rare chance of dropping a new cosmetic item.

[*] Large Barns and Large Coops will now become available to purchase at Ranching Lvl 40.
[/list]

✨ QOL

[list]
[*] 🌼 Perks can now be enabled and disabled from the Dragon Shrine menu.

[*] New default hairstyles have been added.

[*] A big stone has been added to the river in the Narrows for easier traversal on mounts.
[/list]

🎨 Art

[list]
[*] Hayden’s Farm now has animals roaming about.

[*] New animal cosmetics have been added to Hayden’s Shop and the Chicken Statue.

[*] The Cottage Garden Decor furniture set has been added to the game. These items/recipes can be obtained as Renown Rewards between Lv 51-60.

[*] The Noble Cosmetic set has been added to the game. These items can be obtained as Renown Rewards between Lv 61-70.
[/list]

💛 NPCs

[list]
[*] You can now level up all NPCs’ heart levels to 6 hearts.

[*] New dialogue has been added for all NPCs.
[/list]

🔊 Sound

[list]
[*] An additional Rainy Day music track has been added
[/list]

[b][Updates][/b]

🎮 Gameplay

[list]
[*] Treasure Rooms in the Mines now spawn as intended.

[*] 🌼 Chestnuts now visually leave a shell behind when foraged, preventing the foraging spots from being mistaken for dig sites.

[*] 🌼 Fish now ignore collisions when they are attracted to a lure and will no longer be stopped by running into rocks or corner pieces of land.

[*] 🌼 Fishing experience gain has been increased. 

[*] 🌼 Pond Skater’s description has been updated to reflect that it can be found in all seasons.

[*] 🌼The rate of forage and bugs appearing in the Mines has been increased.

[*] Controller Button Mapping: Clicking the Left Stick has been remapped to summon the mount. (prev. used to navigate to the previous toolbar tab).
[/list]

✨ QOL

[list]
[*] The amount of Renown earned per quest is now displayed in the popup upon quest completion and when accepting a quest.

[*] It is now easier to navigate the Skill Perks menu down to view locked perks.

[*] Furniture previews are no longer visible when swimming while holding furniture.

[*] There is now a pop up confirmation when the player upgrades their house.

[*] The game font now supports additional Latin characters.

[*] The Mushroom Cut is now in the Short Hair category instead of Medium Hair.
[/list]

🎨 Art

[list]
[*] Small edits have been made to Juniper’s room, including making Dozy’s bed visible.

[*] Held items now appear above the player’s head gear accessories when the player is facing in any direction.

[*] 🌼 It is now possible to place objects on top of Coral Tables from the Tide furniture set.
[/list]

💛 NPCs

[list]
[*] Terithia now sells additional recipes and Seaweed at her shop.

[*] 🌼 The General Store now sells Soy Sauce.
[/list]

🔊 Sound

[list]
[*] Lowered the wind ambiance volume on the Summit.
[/list]

[Bug Fixes]

🎮 Gameplay

[list]
[*] 🌼 Chickpeas now regrow as per their seed description.

[*] 🌼 Animals now produce products regularly without interruption (it was previously possible to interrupt the product schedule by manually saving and loading the game).

[*] 🌼 Crystal Caterpillar can now be found on both blizzard and snowy days.

[*] Animals no longer walk through fences, into barns, or onto water when exiting the coop.

[*] 🌼 Players can no longer obtain multiple Legendary Fish (extra Legendary Fish in a player’s possession will be removed).

[*] 🌼 Placing items in the Seal Tablet boxes without hitting the Offer button now pops items onto the ground instead of disappearing.

[*] 🌼 Players can no longer duplicate items that are <Hold to Use> by dragging them to a new toolbar slot while using them.

[*] Saving and then loading into the save file will no longer refresh daily requests.

[*] 🌼 Rapidly skipping the bathhouse cutscene no longer traps the player in the bathhouse.

[*] 🌼 The “A Day Well Spent” stamina bonus can no longer be undone by any form of stamina restoration.

[*] 🌼 Using the Summon Rain spell at 1:50am no longer causes the following day to have Clear weather.

[*] 🌼 Players can no longer get stuck inside collisions while swimming (e.g. after diving in a dive spot that is close to a rock).

[*] 🌼 Players can no longer get stuck between the rocks of the southwestern beach island.

[*] 🌼 When switching to the smallest resolution, the screen no longer goes black.

[*] 🌼 Animals can no longer walk on cliffs when dismounting toys.

[*] Collapsing on the farm while placing furniture or saplings no longer causes the previews to display during the End of Day cutscene.

[*] 🌼 Learning the recipe for the Mushroom Stool, Wall/Floor Braziers, Mossy Rugs, and Crystal Lamps of the Cavern Furniture Set will now teach you the recipes for all color variants. (Note: if a player has already learned a recipe for one variant in their game, they’ll need to find the recipe scroll once more to learn all the remaining variants).

[*] Fixed a bug with partially deleted preset outfits.

[*] "Living Off the Land" perk rate has been lowered to work as intended.

[*] New content added that should be available by default (ex. new default player hairstyles) will now be available when loading into older saves.

[*] Using a controller to play and then switching back to mouse no longer renders the scrollbar unscrollable.
[/list]

✨ QOL

[list]
[*] 🌼 Controls can no longer be rebound in a such a way that it causes the player to lose the ability to Reset Controls, hit Enter to Confirm in naming menus, or permanently lose the ability to pick up and place items in storage.

[*] Throwing items now depth sorts correctly.
[/list]

🎨 Art & Visuals
[list]
[*] 🌼 Holding a small animal while entering cutscenes or crafting sequences no longer causes the animal to reappear in the player's hands after every subsequent cutscene.

[*] 🌼 The Lovely Cottage Table can now be rotated (both variants).

[*] 🌼 It is now possible to place objects on top of the Lovely Cottage Table (Oak variant.)

[*] Furniture now depth sorts correctly when placed on top of other furniture.

[*] Going to sleep while picking up an item no longer offsets the player's arms.

[*] Animal icons in the UI now display correctly (The Sheep and Alpaca Fall Variant icons).

[*] 🌼 The Weather Crystal Ball now displays the correct icon for snowy and blizzard days.

[*] The Large Animal Ball Court Toy no longer renders underneath rugs.

[*] Snowy footprints no longer appear when walking in the bathhouse or the Mines Entry room.

[*] The Wishing Well and Chicken Statue now display the correct Winter sprite.

[*] The Hawthorn sapling now appears in the appropriate seasonal color.

[*] The log pile by the Carpenter’s Shop’s shadow now displays correctly. 
[/list]

🖥️ UI

[list]
[*] Legendary Fish now have the museum donation icon in their New Item popup.

[*] Distinct icons for manual saves and autosaves in the Load Game menu have been restored.

[*] 🌼 The Giant Koi fish now displays the correct icon.

[*] 🌼 The color of the Gold Stud Earrings now displays correctly in the menu.

[*] 🌼 The glyph on controller/SteamDeck for Plant Grass Starter is now correct

[*] Improved tool-charged tile indicator fade.

[*] Item names no longer spill over in the Quest UI turn in popup.

[*] Seal Offering UI text no longer spills over.

[*] The Fishing Tutorial popup no longer interferes with the Blacksmithing menu if a player acquires their first rod by blacksmithing.

[*] The “learned recipe” popup no longer appears when a recipe scroll bundle item is acquired.

[*] 🌼 When purchasing animals from Hayden’s Shop the proper amount of tesserae now visual subtracts.

[*] Rapidly clicking in and out of the Skill Perks menu no longer distorts the menu.
 
[*] The UI elements behind the animal adoption popup no longer go blank.
[/list]

💛 NPCs & Quests

[list]
[*] Market vendors inventory rotation is now working as intended.

[*] 🌼 The player now receives the correct letter from Adeline after her Four Heart event.

[*] 🌼 Initiating certain cutscenes (ex. Ryis’ 2 Heart event) at the Inn after 8pm no longer causes the player to get stuck.

[*] Balor’s Two Heart quest now rewards 200t as intended.

[*] 🌼 Merri can no longer sell two Bakery Dessert Case recipes at once.

[*] Balor can no longer sell two Lemons at once.

[*] Vendors no longer say regular daytime dialogue when packing up.

[*] Updated speaker info to correct NPC for specific dialogues.
[/list]

🔊 Sound

[list]
[*] All doors now make the correct closing sound.
[/list]

❌ Crash Fixes

[list]
[*] 🌼 Initiating a conversation with an NPC while transitioning into a cutscene no longer causes a crash.

[*] 🌼 Placing down two adjacent fences on top of a hay bale no longer crashes the game.

[*] 🌼 Placing furniture in specific spots that interferes with The Unusual Tree cutscene on Spring 2 no longer crashes the game. Any furniture interfering with the cutscene will now be returned to item form and can be picked up after the cutscene ends.
[/list]


As always, thank you so much for your support. We hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.11.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/cf62c096e637e74cb140e587460d7da5397fdc7c.png[/img]
Fields of Mistria’s v0.11.5 Patch is here! The primary purpose of this patch is to fix the Steam Cloud Save issue that some players are experiencing. The patch also contains some minor bug fixes and additional crash fixes. As always, Thank you to everyone who’s reported bugs to us. To report a bug, please fill out our form [url=https://www.fieldsofmistria.com/feedback-and-bug-reports]here[/url]. 

Patch notes will feature a 🌼 emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback!

[b]v0.11.5 Patch Notes:[/b]

[Highlights]
[list]
[*] 🌼 Sunflower seeds have been added to the General Store’s stock in the Summer.
[*] 🌼 The Orange Crop Sign furniture item has been added to the Fall Crop Sign Set.
[*] 🌼 “Pause Audio on Unfocus” toggle added to the Audio Settings.
[*] Henrietta now has a birthday gift line.
[/list]
[Updates]
🎮 Gameplay
[list]
[*] 🌼 Sage can now be found on the beach map in Summer.
[/list]

[Bug Fixes]
🎮 Gameplay
[list]
[*] Placing a storage chest on a table and destroying it with a pick axe will now cause its content to drop nearby instead of in the corner of the room.
[*] 🌼 The Pomegranate Crop Sign furniture item is now properly listed in the Winter Crop Sign Set.
[/list]

✨ QOL
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud saving now works properly.*
[*] Save files are much less likely to become corrupted if saving is interrupted.
[*] Improved game performance during and after a rainy day.
[/list]

💛 NPCs
[list]
[*] Luc no longer makes bug-specific comments about non-bug gifts.
[*] Townsfolk no longer occasionally disappear on Fridays.
[/list]

🎨 Art
[list]
[*] The horn color on the sleeping female cow has been updated.
[/list]

❌ Crash Fixes
[list]
[*] Inspecting items in your inventory no longer occasionally crashes the game.
[*] Sowing seeds no longer occasionally crashes the game.
[*] Collected Items and Notification pop-ups no longer occasionally crash the game.
[/list]

*Additional Notes:
[i]Fixing the Steam Cloud Save issue involved changing the format of our saves from a folder of files to one single file. This means you can no longer manually interact with your saves without unpacking them. For those of you who wish to interact with your save files directly, we have publicly released one of our tools to unpack your save and return it to its previous format: [url=https://github.com/NPC-Studio/vaultc]https://github.com/NPC-Studio/vaultc[/url][/i]

notes.title: Fields of Mistria’s first patch is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/348218124c8948a8d9ea22e74de50b487ed3c3f3.png[/img]
Fields of Mistria’s first patch is here! For this patch, the team primarily focused on game stability and bug fixes. Thank you to everyone who’s reported bugs to us. To report a bug, please fill out our form [url=https://www.fieldsofmistria.com/feedback-and-bug-reports]here[/url].

[b]Patch notes will feature a 🌼 emoji whenever the change is based on community feedback![/b]

[b]v0.11.4 Patch Notes:[/b]

[Highlights]
[list]
[*] Additional gift lines have been added for all NPCs.
[*] 🌼 The Worn Watering Can, Worn Hoe, and Worn Sword are now sold at the General Store.
[*] Several issues causing the game to crash have been fixed.
[/list]

[New Features]
[list]
[*] New dialogue has been added for Balor at the Saturday Market.
[*] 🌼 Additional colors for the Basic Cape.
[/list]

[Updates]
🎮 Gameplay
[list]
[*] The heights of various wall furniture items have been adjusted. Primarily the Rustic Cabin Wall Shelf and the Lovely Cottage Wall Flowers.
[*] Female and male animals expecting offspring can no longer be sold, moved to a different farm building, or moved into the daycare. Note: animals in daycare or moved between buildings with active expectant status have reverted status but remain in their current daycare/building slots.
[/list]
✨ QOL
[list]
[*] When attempting to load an invalid save the game now displays an invalid save popup rather than crash on startup.*
[/list]

💛 NPCs
[list]
[*] Various small typo/spelling corrections and line edits have been made.
[*] Mild Spoiler: Potato is now a liked gift for Holt instead of accidentally both liked and loved.
[*] Mild Spoiler: Crystal Berries are now a loved gift for Darcy instead of accidentally both liked and loved. The freed liked slot is now a new gift.
[/list]

[Bug Fixes]
🎮 Gameplay
[list]
[*] Black Rabbits are now Tier 2 instead of Tier 3.
[*] The player no longer wakes up stuck in a void after fainting in the Mines or passing out at 2 am if they do not have a bed in their house.
[*] Perks no longer trigger before they have been unlocked.
[*] Weather particles no longer reappear during cutscenes if Weather Particle Strength in Accessibility Settings is set to None.
[*] Infused weapons' damage numbers now always round to the nearest integer.
[*] Swinging your sword in a room transition no longer causes the player to slide in an idle animation.
[*] Holding a consumable item while interacting with the inn soup no longer consumes the item.
[*] The player now resolves their animation when a dialogue textbox appears.
[*] Closing the inventory and quickly hitting L or R on the controller no longer freezes the game.
[*] Scrolling in the toolbar from one cosmetic item to another now changes the player's held item.
[*] Fixed a bug where movement speed was increased by holding Hasty armor.
[*] Fixed a bug where Hasty armor could stack in unexpected ways (sorry).
[*] Mild Spoiler: The beach bridge will now repair properly, even if you skip the repair cutscene. Note: If you previously skipped the cutscene, your bridge should now be repaired.
[/list]
💛 NPCs
[list]
[*] Dozy and Henrietta no longer say dialogue intended for human NPCs.
[*] Disliked gifts given on an NPC's birthday no longer trigger a placeholder birthday line.
[*] "Request for Emerald" and "Request for Rabbit Wool" now list the appropriate NPC in the quest objective.
[/list]
❌ Crash Fixes
[list]
[*] Walking in front of Dozy when he faces west at the Spring Festival no longer crashes the game (Dozy says he's sorry about that).
[*] NPC's database position differing from their actual position no longer crashes the game.
[*] Invalid localization key for input_reset_controls no longer crashes the game. 
[*] Exiting the inventory page after swapping a held item with the cursor no longer crashes the game. 
[*] Using the pickaxe at 2am no longer crashes the game.
[*] Fishing will no longer occasionally cause the game to crash.
[*] Trying to put a small animal into a shipping bin no longer crashes the game (note: animals can be sold via the shop menu at Sweetwater Farm)
[/list]

*Additional Notes
We are working to fix an issue with Steam's Cloud Save feature that is causing invalid saves. If you get an "Invalid Save" popup when trying to load the game, we recommend turning off Cloud Saves and playing the game on the previous device it was saved on until we are able to fix the issue.

We are continuing to work on additional bugs that have been reported, and welcome you to report any you encounter via our bug report form [url=https://www.fieldsofmistria.com/feedback-and-bug-reports]here[/url].

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Fields of Mistria will enter Early Access on August 5th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186863/948157d02fc21e456275fd43138ee342e1820fe7.png[/img]
We are delighted to announce that Fields of Mistria will enter Early Access on August 5th for $13.99 USD! 🌼

We've been hard at work filling Mistria with magic, and we can't wait for you to experience it!

So, why Early Access, you ask? Early Access will allow us to hear your feedback as we continue to shape and refine the game in the leadup to the 1.0 release. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts along the way!
 
Now, let's talk about what you can expect in Mistria during Early Access:

🌾 Gameplay
[list]
[*] Play through the four seasons with unique weather, crops, forage, fish, insects, and more!
[*] Raise a variety of adorable animals, and even breed them to discover rare color variants.
[*] Give your animals toys to play with, and even dress them up with their own cosmetics!
[*] Crafting, Cooking, and Blacksmithing are available with over 600 items to craft!
[*] Complete over 50 museum sets through fishing, bug catching, farming, mining, and archaeology!
[*] Explore the depths below Mistria (down to level 60 with more to come) with engaging combat and surprises in store.
[*] Upgrade your home (with more upgrades to come)  and customize it with over 200 available items.
[*] Unlock Powerful Magic Spells to aid you in your experience.
[*] Check out our website for the full list!
[/list]

💖 Villagers
[list]
[*] Meet and befriend 30+ characters, including 10 marriage candidates and 2 special candidates.
[*] Raise marriage candidate hearts up to 4 hearts and unlock their unique 2 and 4 heart events. Additional heart level progression and events will be added up to 10 hearts via planned updates.
[*] Get to know the villagers' dynamic daily routines that change based on seasons, weather, and special events.
[*] Villagers have unique seasonal outfits and special beach outfits for the romanceables.
[*] Villagers have a variety of beautiful and expressive animated portraits.
[/list]

📖 Story
[list]
[*] Rebuild and revitalize Mistria through a series of main story quests, with future content planned.
[*] Raise Mistria’s renown and Star Rank from a lowly Wood Star rank up through Sapphire Star rank (with more ranks on the way via planned updates).
[*] Begin to unravel the mysteries of the town’s past and the return of magic power to the land.
[*] Enjoy 5,000+ lines of unique character dialogue and dozens of cutscenes.
[*] Complete dozens of hand-written requests available daily at the town’s request board, with more on the way.
[/list]

And that's just the beginning! With regular updates planned throughout Early Access, there will always be something new coming to Mistria! Keep an eye on our social media channels, website, and Steam page for all the latest updates and roadmaps as they become available!
